environment.description: Bare-metal deployment on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS. The Go binary runs as uid 1000 with write access to /var/app/plugins/ and the static assets directory /var/app/static/. No containerization. The filesystem is ext4 with standard permissions. Nginx reverse proxy in front passes WebSocket connections through with no content inspection. The HTML page loads scripts without integrity attributes. No CSP headers configured on Nginx.

config.reverse_proxy: nginx 1.24 with proxy_pass, no WAF modules
